An '''Imperial military interrogator''' was an owner of a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] named [[Gorn Sweevas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was interrogating [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], when one of the spies suddenly used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to escape, release other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and kill all Imperials present, including Sweevas' master. Sweevas himself escaped to safety and asked another Imperial to come into the lab and kill the freed prisoners.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorn Sweevas's master was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' heroic "Botched Interrogation."
